renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] World-bearing His mark; whole mirrored by power in self-seeing.

paragraphs.text: Carrying the whole world is simply what marks Him out. And the entire world stands reflected — mirrored by His own power — inside His seeing of Himself.
His mark: world-bearing. His mirror: self-seeing, with the whole reflected in it by power.

paragraphs.text: World-bearing is His signature. The all shows up mirrored inside His own self-seeing, and power does the mirroring.
Mark: bears the world. Manner: mirrors it in self-seeing, by power.
